title: Cone Zero Ceramics School

services.name: Youth Classes
services.desc: We have 2 types of class offerings: Ongoing classes & Themed multi-week classes. The studio is equipped with 12 pottery wheels, a slab roller, an extruder, and a large hand-building table with a range of tools and molds. We offer a variety of cone 6 clay bodies and food-safe glazes. Ongoing classes are perfect for individuals who want to explore ceramics without committing, need additional guidance, or require flexibility due to a busy schedule. These classes are open to beginners and advanced students! Please note: You will not complete a piece in one class. To make a ceramic pot, the clay is first formed when wet, then edited, dried, fired, glazed, and fired again. Multiple class sessions
